simple.meaning: פָּשַׁע (pâshaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to break away (from just authority), i.e. trespass , apostatize , quarrel.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 41 times across 1 Kings, 2 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Ezra, Psalms, and 9 more, beginning at 1 Kings 8:50. Its contexts include kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פָּשַׁע (H6586).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: פָּשַׁע (pâshaʻ) / H6586 is traced through 1 Kings 8:50, 1 Kings 12:19, 2 Kings 1:1, 2 Kings 3:5 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: to break away (from just authority), i.e. trespass , apostatize , quarrel
definitions.full: H6586. pasha מָּשַׁע verb rebel, transgress (Late Hebrew id. ; Syriac is be terrified , tepid,inspid );- Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳פ 2Kin 3:7 +, 2 feminine singular מָּשַׁ֫עַתְּ Zeph 3:11 ; מָּשָׁ֑עתְּ Jer 3:13 , etc.; Imperfect יִפְשַׁע Prov 28:21 + 8 t. Imperfect Imperative ; masculine plural מִּשְׁעוּ Amos 4:4 ; Infinitive absolute ? מָּשֹׁעַ Isa 59:13 ; construct מְּשֹׁעַ Amos 4:4 ; Ezek 10:13 ; Participle מּשֵׁעַ Isa 48:8 ; מּשְׁעִים 1:28 +, etc.;- 1 rebel, revolt , of nations, with בְּ against , 1Kin 12:19 ; 2Kin 1:1 ; 3:5 , 7 ; 2Chr 10:19 ; absolute 2Kin 8:22 , יַד מִתַּחַת 8:20 ; 8:22 ; 2Chr 21:8 , 10 (twice in verse); בִי מָּֽשְׁעוּ Isa 1:2 (Israel under figure of ׳י s sons). 2 transgress against God, absolute Isa 1:28 ; 46:8 ; 48:8 ; 53:12 (twice in verse); Hosea 14:10; Amos 4:4 (twice in verse); Lam 3:42 ; Dan 8:23 ; Psa 37:38 ; 51:15 , for ( עַל ) a bit of bread Prov 28:21 ; הַזֶּה בַּרָּבָר Ezra 10:13 in this thing ; על תּוֺרָתִי Hosea 8:1 ; elsewhere with בְּ against God: ׳פ ׳ב Isa 43:27 ; 59:13 ; 66:24 ; Jer 2:8 , 29 ; 3:13 ; 33:8 ; Ezek 2:3 ; 20:38 ; Hosea 7:13 ; פ אשׁר ׳מְּשִׁעִים ב 1Kin 8:50 ; Ezek 18:31 ; פ אשׁר ׳עלילות ב Zeph 3:11 . Niph`al Perfect 3masculine singular נִפְשַׁע אָח (van d. H. Participle נִפְשָׁע ) a brother (who has been) offended Prov 18:19 , but very dubious, compare Toy.
